name: sam3
note: SAM 3 in transformers' layout (Sam3Model, Sam3TrackerModel), from jetjodh/sam3, a public copy of Meta's gated facebook/sam3 (not open to the account; scene.py's SAM3_WEIGHTS). The SAM License grants use, copies and derivatives royalty-free, commercial use included; a copy passed on carries the licence, a publication acknowledges SAM, and trade-control, military and weapons uses are excluded. The original checkpoint sam3.pt is left out. sam-run sets SAM3_WEIGHTS to its folder.

name: sam2.1-hiera-large
note: SAM 2.1 large for segment_worker.py, which loads it by repository id (build_sam2_hf); sam-run lays it out as a Hugging Face hub cache (runtime/hf_cache.py) so the id resolves offline. Code and weights Apache-2.0.

name: moge-2-vitl-normal
note: MoGe-2 for scene/depth.py, which loads it by repository id; sam-run lays it out as a Hugging Face hub cache (runtime/hf_cache.py). Code MIT with DINOv2 parts under Apache-2.0, in the image at the commit the Dockerfile pins.

name: birefnet-general-lite
note: BiRefNet-lite as rembg's ONNX file (rembg's release v0.0.0, md5 4fab47adc4ff364be1713e97b7e66334 as closeups_setup.sh checks); sam-run links it as U2NET_HOME/birefnet-general-lite.onnx, the name rembg looks for. BiRefNet MIT, rembg MIT.

name: flux2-klein-4b
note: FLUX.2 klein 4B in diffusers' layout (picture_setup.sh's and scene_setup.sh's allow patterns); the single-file checkpoint and the sample pictures are left out. sam-run links it to PROPS_HOME/flux2-klein, pictures-run to /root/model.
